# @openlaunchsdk/raster (v1.2.0)

GeoTIFF/COG pixel decoder, quality masks, NDVI, DEM mesh. Install only the capabilities your application needs:

```sh
npm install @openlaunchsdk/raster
```

```ts
import { decodeGeoTiff, readCogWindowUrl, ndviRaster, clipRasterToAoi } from '@openlaunchsdk/raster';
```

Use @openlaunchsdk/earth for STAC catalog provider discovery; this package provides raster math and pixel fetch/decode functions.

**Distribution:** generated by the monorepo build into `dist/esm`, `dist/cjs` and `dist/types`. Root `openlaunch-sdk` v1.1 remains the backwards-compatible umbrella package. Internal module subpaths are implementation details and not intended as stable public APIs.

Source: [kobyldav/openlaunch-sdk](https://github.com/kobyldav/openlaunch-sdk). MIT license. Flight/orbit calculations are research-grade, not safety qualified.

## Full georeferenced index maps (v1.2)

`ndviRaster(red,nir)`, `ndwiRaster(green,nir)`,
`ndmiRaster(nir,swir1)` and `nbrRaster(nir,swir2)`
operate on physically calibrated and co-registered `RasterGrid` arrays.
Each rejects mismatched grids and retains `NaN` invalid/cloud-masked values.
The site renders actual SDK-generated pixels; no imaginary satellite imagery.
